content.title: About
content.content: Greens with ham or pork is a ready‑to‑eat mix of fresh leafy greens (spinach, lettuce, arugula) combined with selected pieces of ham or boiled pork. The product pairs the crisp texture of the greens with the savory, slightly salty flavor of the meat, making it a convenient option for quick lunches and snacks.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The combination of leafy greens and meat is a staple in Mediterranean cuisine.
The ham used is typically smoked, giving the mix a distinctive aroma.
Pork in the blend is usually pre‑cooked and diced for even distribution.
The product is often sold in vacuum‑sealed packs that keep it fresh for up to 7 days in the fridge.
Leafy greens provide vitamins A, C and K, while the meat adds protein and iron.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Ham or pork supplies high‑quality protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals from greens
items.content: Leafy vegetables are rich in vitamin K for blood clotting, as well as vitamin C and folate.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin C and antioxidants from the greens help strengthen the immune system.

items.title: Sustained energy
items.content: The blend of protein and modest fat provides lasting satiety without sharp blood‑sugar spikes.

items.title: Iron
items.content: Pork contains heme iron, which is more readily absorbed than plant‑based iron.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Ham often contains a lot of salt, which may be a concern for people with hypertension.

items.title: Meat allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic or intolerant to pork or processed meat products.

items.title: Shelf life
items.content: The product loses freshness quickly after opening; keep it refrigerated and consume within 3‑4 days.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Preservatives may be used to extend shelf life, which some consumers prefer to avoid.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The mix is ready to eat: add it to salads, use as a sandwich filling, wrap in a flatbread, or toss into a quick vegetable omelet. For extra flavor, briefly sauté the mixture in a pan.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C. After opening, reseal tightly or transfer to an airtight container. Discard if it develops an off‑odor or discoloration.
